defaultPrompt: Generate a futty card style using my team crest.
Create a metallic card template from my organization crest.
Check whether the ClubATX futty card generation tool is available.
interface.longDescription: Generate reusable football player card style PNGs from a saved ClubATX team or organization crest, or a crest image in the configured Blob store. Uses the existing ClubATX MCP endpoint and administrator OAuth sign-in. Returns a new card template with blank player and statistics areas without replacing the original crest.

name: clubatx-futty-cards
description: Generate crest-based futty football card style templates through the ClubATX MCP server.
